body: Not multibaggers for public investors. Waaree Energies: IPO Oct 2024 at ₹1,503; first weekly close ₹2,890; ATH ₹3,634 (Sep 2025); ₹2,433 on 19 Nov 2026 (1.6x the issue price, −33% from ATH). TTM EPS ₹37.5 → ₹135.6 (3.6x) while P/E fell from 84 to 18. Premier Energies: IPO Sep 2024 at ₹450; first close ₹1,096; ATH ₹1,325 (Jan 2025); low ₹683 (−48%); ₹830 now. EPS ₹12.8 → ₹39 (3.1x) while P/E fell from 214 to 21. Operations were excellent: Waaree revenue ₹14.4k cr (FY25) → ₹26.5k cr (FY26), OPM 19–22%; Premier OPM ~30%. The multiple engine ran backwards: listing P/Es priced in years of supernormal solar-manufacturing margins, which were protected by import duties/ALMM and US demand, while industry-wide module and cell capacity announcements (visible in MNRE lists and company press releases) signalled future margin pressure (narrative unverified). Most of the multibagger return went to pre-IPO holders. Lesson: a sector at peak policy support plus IPO-time P/E of 80–200 means EPS can triple and the stock still go nowhere. The twin engine needs a low starting multiple.

data.early_signals: warning: industry capacity race + IPO-time P/E
data.lesson: P/E engine can fully offset 3x EPS

title: Waaree & Premier Energies 2024–26: EPS tripled, stocks fell (boom-IPO counter-case)

body: Split-adjusted ₹10.2 (Jan 2013) → ATH ₹960 (Dec 2024) ≈94x; standalone P/E 4.9 → 42 (8.6x) × implied EPS ~10.9x. ₹737 on 19 Nov 2026 (−23%). Drawdowns were mild: −35% (2016), −34% (COVID), −38% (Dec 2024–Mar 2026). Early signal in filings: value-added products (aquaculture cage nets for salmon farms, sports nets, geosynthetics, specialty ropes) rose from ~35% of the mix in FY14 to ~75% in FY20 (~80% by 2026). Aquaculture is ~35% of revenue and the highest-margin segment. Consolidated sales grew only modestly (₹782 cr FY15 → ₹1,018 cr FY19), but OPM rose from 10% to 19% and PAT tripled (₹43 cr → ₹126 cr). Profit growing 3x faster than revenue at a 5x P/E is the classic mix-shift signature. Stalled: since FY21 revenue growth has been ~8–10%, P/E has stayed at 30–40, and the stock has gone sideways for about four years (₹636 end-2021 → ₹737). Lesson: mix shift gives a one-time margin step-up plus a rerating. After that the stock compounds only at revenue growth, so the rerating phase is where the multibagger is made.

data.early_signals: VAP mix 35%→75%; PAT 3x on sales +30%; P/E ~5
data.lesson: mix-shift step-up is a one-time engine
